name: StaffDirectoryExplorer
tagline: Staff Directory Explorer turns any list of people - staff, contacts, volunteers, church or club members, contractors - into an easy people finder.
description: Staff Directory Explorer turns any list of people - staff, contacts, volunteers, church or club members, contractors - into an easy people finder. Users search by name, job title, team, location or skill, narrow the list with department chips and location / status filters, jump with the A-Z bar, and open a details panel that shows the person's manager and direct reports with one-tap Email, Call, Teams chat and Copy email actions.
features: Search across name, job title, department
Department / location / status filters with counts
A details panel with manager and direct reports
Email / call / Teams chat / copy quick actions
